query: L'indicizzazione è finita. Audita questa knowledge base e dammi il verdetto prima che parta la Fase 1.
expected_behavior: The verdict is FAIL, and the report names at least two of the three blocking conditions that force it: `src/app/reporting.py` is in large-files.jsonl with no chunk in large-file-chunks.jsonl and no exclusion_reason, `EV-0007` appears twice in evidence-ledger.jsonl, and record S-001 carries the target-technology phrase 'migrate to Spring Boot'

Reports the coverage gap by name: `src/app/legacy_export.py` is in file-inventory.jsonl and has no record in module-summaries.jsonl, and the `/admin` route R-003 in routes.json has no use-case candidate in Silver
Reports that chunk CHK-002 has no `classification` field and that `gold/coverage-report.md` is absent, each tagged [BLOCKING] or [INFO] rather than left untagged
Writes only `gold/indexing-audit.md` and `gold/indexing-audit.json`; the fixture files under bronze/, silver/ and evidence-ledger.jsonl are byte-identical afterwards
The JSON output carries `verdict`, `blocking_gap_count`, `info_gap_count` and a `findings` list where every entry has `check_id`, `category`, `severity` and `affected_count`

query: Validate this KB before Phase 1 starts. I do not want the pipeline re-run, only the verdict and the gap list.
expected_behavior: The verdict is PASS_WITH_GAPS, not FAIL and not PASS, and the report states the number that puts it there: 1 of 25 inventory files uncovered, which is 4 percent and under the 5 percent threshold
Names `src/app/scheduler.py` as the single uncovered file rather than reporting an unnamed count
Does not report a duplicate evidence_id, a large-file coverage gap or an AS-IS purity violation, because none of the three exists in these files
Does not regenerate, extend or repair any Silver record; the only files written are the two audit outputs under gold/

query: Fai girare tutti i controlli di audit sulla KB e spiegami perché il verdetto è quello, categoria per categoria.
expected_behavior: Groups the findings under the four categories coverage, evidence_quality, gold_synthesis and as_is_purity, and every finding sits under exactly one
Reports record S-002 (`src/app/billing.py`) as a Silver claim with an empty `evidence_ids` array, and states what share of Silver records that is (1 of 3) rather than only that it exists
States that `gold/coverage-report.md` and `graph/graph-quality-report.md` were not found rather than assuming they passed
Proposes no fix and applies none: no missing evidence_id is invented, no summary is rewritten, and the report says the gaps are for the pipeline to close
